answer: In this EigenTrust-style network, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so only sustained honest service maintains influence over time. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits gains from sybil rings lacking trusted external links: freshly spawned identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus. A long voyage of verified cooperation—not a pearl of fabricated endorsements or a zephyr of briefly exchanged ratings—is needed to earn durable trust.
